contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [?]+EDDR [?]ARD RE[?]X, if so ; R/ +GODRIC ON LINC

Silver. Coin, Penny of Edward the Confessor (1042-1066) as identified by the finder, moneyer Godric at Lincoln mint. An astonishingly bright and crisp coin, though slightly bent. Mossop 1970 plate 72 nos 14-19. Obverse description: Draped, diademed and cuirassed bust left, no sceptre, either initial cross pattee or an X of that form.
